title: Replace hero image with uploaded spices/herbs flat-lay photo

requirements.text: Replace the current hero background image in the Hero component with the newly generated static asset (frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg). The image should be used as the full-screen background of the hero section, preserving all existing text overlays, gradient overlays, Ken Burns animation, and CTA buttons without any other changes.

quotes: Use this image as hero image simple. Replace the image
I'll replace the current hero image with your uploaded spices/herbs photo

acceptanceCriteria: The hero section displays the spices and herbs flat-lay photo (mortar and pestle, turmeric, ginger, garlic, rosemary, lemon) as its background image
All existing hero text, gradient overlays, Ken Burns zoom animation, and CTA buttons remain intact and functional
No other sections or components are altered
The image renders correctly on both desktop and mobile viewports

constraints: Do not modify any hero text, overlays, animations, or CTA buttons — only swap the background image source
Do not change any backend code or other frontend components
nonGoals: Changing hero layout, typography, or color scheme
Modifying any page other than the Hero component

required: Flat-lay photograph of Ayurvedic spices and herbs on a rustic wooden surface: stone mortar and pestle filled with turmeric powder, fresh ginger root and slices, whole garlic bulbs and cloves, rosemary sprigs, cinnamon sticks, lemon halves, scattered turmeric and red spice powders, fresh basil leaves, a small bowl of golden turmeric, and a bottle of golden oil in the background (hero-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg)
